summary: Added headless cmd/fontgallery tool, TestFontGolden snapshot tests with -update flag, extended TestBlockRowWidths, and added TestCharsetCoverage test.

Re-authored the default 'block' font as a clean, legible, medium-weight 5-row static glyph map covering the full uppercase charset (added missing ; & %), migrating it onto the shared NewBlock code path (compact already uses it; heavy will follow) and retiring the legacy RenderString/StringWidth/letters machinery + orphaned font_test.go. Provenance: cfonts block/simpleBlock checked but GPL-3.0 (incompatible with plaqq MIT), so glyphs hand-authored, not transcribed. Block width+coverage+golden green; gallery eyeballed. heavy/compact still red by design (separate laps).

Re-authored the 'heavy' font as a hand-authored 7-row solid block map (heavy.go): full uppercase charset (incl. ; & %), full blocks for strokes with half blocks only at edges. Removed the banner3-derived heavy registration from figlet.go. Width + coverage + golden green for heavy; gallery eyeballed. compact still red (separate lap).

BUDGET-EXHAUSTED HANDOFF (no bug blocker — all research done, zero code written; working tree clean, no edits, no commits). Lap plaq-9b22 = re-author compact font (tasks 2.4-2.5). Compact is currently its ORIGINAL quadrant-based 3-row map; TestCharsetCoverage FAILS because compact is missing ';','&','%'. RESEARCH COMPLETE + VERIFIED THIS RUN: (1) pagga LICENCE verified from upstream https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cacalabs/toilet/master/COPYING AND the pagga.tlf header = 'Do What The Fuck You Want To Public License v2' (Sam Hocevar 2010), which IS compatible with plaqq MIT — so transcription IS permitted (unlike cfonts which was GPL-3.0, hence block/heavy were hand-authored). Full pagga.tlf was fetched successfully; network worked this run. (2) pagga = clean 3-row half-block face using ONLY U+2580 ▀, U+2584 ▄, U+2588 █, and U+2591 ░ as background padding, 3 cells wide per glyph + the leading ░ pad column. pagga covers ALL base ASCII printables ('font creation, all base characters') INCLUDING the missing ; & %. NEXT-RUN RECIPE (execute in order): (a) Overwrite internal/font/compact.go: replace the quadrant (▙▟▜▛▗▖▝▘▌▐) map with transcribed pagga glyphs for charset A-Z 0-9 ! ? . , : ; ' - / & % ( ) + space; TRANSLATION RULE: map every ░ -> space, keep ▀▄█ verbatim, drop pagga's leading pad column so each glyph is exactly 3 cells wide (equal-width rows, satisfies TestBlockRowWidths). Parse pagga.tlf in ASCII order (glyphs start at codepoint 32, 3 rows separated by @, glyphs separated by @@). ; is ASCII 59, & is 38, % is 37. (b) Add a provenance header comment on compactGlyphs citing TOIlet pagga.tlf by Sam Hocevar, WTFPL v2, MIT-compatible, with the source URL. (c) Regenerate snapshot: go test -run TestFontGolden ./internal/font/ -update. (d) Validate: gofmt -w internal/font/compact.go && go vet ./... && go build ./... && go test ./... (expect TestCharsetCoverage/compact + TestBlockRowWidths/compact + TestFontGolden/compact green; TestNamesIncludeExpected still passes since figlet.go still registers go-figure fonts — that deletion is lap plaq-f0ee, NOT this lap). (e) go run ./cmd/fontgallery and eyeball compact. DO NOT: edit tasks.md, registry_test.go, or figlet.go (out of scope). DESIGN NOTE for the fresh run to decide: recommend adopting pagga verbatim (it is the design's NAMED source for compact and a clean pure ▀▄█ face) rather than the current quadrant hybrid, which deviates from the design's '3-row half-block (▀▄█)' intent. The only real risk is transcribing a glyph's ░->space mapping wrong or miscounting pagga ASCII positions; both are mechanical.
